Disappointed with the food, service, and how feedback was handled

I had a pretty good experience at Union Pizza before, so I was really disappointed this time.

I am organizing a birthday for a little one and have already sent the cake to the restaurant. The staff confirmed they will help bring out the cake and sing "Happy Birthday" at the end of the meal. However, at the end of the meal when I asked for cake, the staff only brought the whole bag of cake to the table, and then there was no further assistance or guidance.

I proactively ordered dessert and specifically asked a staff member in a black shirt to help bring it out with candles and sing "Happy Birthday." However, in the end, no birthday party took place, and no one proactively explained it to me. This is a child's birthday, so I'm quite disappointed, especially since the support was discussed and confirmed beforehand.

Regarding the food, the Volcano Chocolate cake was dry and hard, not achieving the texture I expected from this dish.

More worryingly, after the meal, one person in my group developed stomach pain and had to take medicine. Currently, after about 2 days, you have gone past the symptoms. I do not assert that the cause was the restaurant's food without verification results, but I proactively responded to Union Pizza immediately afterward.

The restaurant has apologized and stated that they will forward the information to the relevant department for investigation, but also announced that it will take about 5 business days to review. I understand the restaurant needs time to verify the matter, but regarding the issue related to customer health, I hope for a more proactive and quick resolution.

Overall, this was an experience that did not meet my expectations, from the quality of some dishes, the proactiveness in birthday service, to how the issue was handled after the meal. Hope Union Pizza will seriously review and provide a clear response, and improve the process so that similar experiences do not happen to other customers.

Disappointed with the food, service, and handling of feedback

I have had good experiences at Union Pizza before, so I was genuinely disappointed this time.

I organized a birthday celebration for a child and had the birthday cake delivered to the restaurant in advance. The staff confirmed that they would help bring out the cake and sing "Happy Birthday" at the end of the meal. However, when I asked for the cake, the staff simply brought out the entire cake bag and placed it on the table, with no further assistance or guidance.

I then ordered an additional dessert and personally asked another staff member, who was wearing a black shirt, to bring the dessert with a candle and help with the birthday celebration. Unfortunately, nothing happened in the end, and no one proactively explained what had happened. Since this was a birthday celebration for a child, I found this quite disappointing, especially as the arrangement had been discussed and confirmed in advance.

As for the food, the Chocolate Lava Cake was dry and hard, which was not what I expected from this dessert.

More concerningly, after the meal, one person in our group experienced stomach pain and had to take medication. After about two days, the symptoms have now completely gone. I am not claiming that the symptoms were caused by the restaurant’s food without an investigation or confirmation, but I did proactively report the incident to Union Pizza.

The restaurant apologized and said that the relevant department would look into the matter, but also informed me that it would take approximately 5 working days to investigate. I understand that the restaurant needs time to verify what happened, but when a customer's health is involved, I expected a more proactive and timely response.

Overall, this was an experience that did not meet my expectations, from the quality of some of the food, to the lack of initiative in handling the birthday celebration, and the way the issue after the meal was handled.

I hope Union Pizza will take this feedback seriously, provide a clear response after completing the investigation, and improve its procedures to prevent similar experiences for other customers.
